notes.excerpt: Gross Revenue from sale of products and services and Excise duty for the quarters ended 30th September, 2026, 30th June, 2026 and six months ended 30th September, 2026 reflect the impact of sharp increase in Excise duty and are not strictly comparable with those of the previous periods.

the financial results of the Group and 'Paperboards, Paper & Packaging' segment include those of 'Century Pulp and Paper' from 1st August, 2026 and consequently are not comparable with previous periods.

The financial results of the Group and 'FMCG-Others' segment include those of Sproutlife with effect from 1st April, 2026. Accordingly, results of the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 are not comparable with previous periods.

source.excerpt: Consequent to expiry of the GST Compensation Cess, the Government of India increased GST and Central Excise duty on cigarettes with effect from 1st February, 2026.
